_comment: Per-client script numbers. Read by scripts/script_score.py and scripts/beat_plan.py. ⛔ There are NO house defaults here on purpose: a 6s hook floor is right for one brief and fails every script in another. Both tools refuse to run rather than assume. Copy to script.<client>.json and fill in.
_runtime_target_s: Total runtime the client's channel wants. Cross-check against the delivery preset's duration_window_s in assets/delivery-formats.json.
_hook_seconds_min: Floor, not a target. A hook card has to be READ, not glimpsed — but the right floor depends on how much text it carries and on the language. Measure it; do not inherit it.
_cta_seconds: The resolved state plus one ask.
_beat_seconds: ⛔ MEASURED, not guessed: time one finished scene wall to wall across a few episodes. This is the divisor that sets the scene count, so an invented value invents the structure.
_max_words_per_line: Spoken-word ceiling per line. Language-dependent — the same idea is longer in some languages than others.
_speakers: 1 = monologue (no alternation to keep; its rhythm test is inevitability). 2 = two-hander.
